notes.title: Loot Box Quest now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4586827/c43b034cf1dc3f0a2e2f0da552aa94f6db216a23.jpg[/img]

Hi DLC fans (or perhaps enemies)!

I've recently released a new game you might be interested in: Loot Box Quest!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/758500/Loot_Box_Quest/

The spiritual successor to DLC Quest! Earn that sense of pride and accomplishment in the way that only repetitive clicking can deliver. It's a clicker game, so chill out, have a few chuckles, and watch numbers get bigger while the industry burns around us all.

If you like clicker games, maybe check it out!
- Ben
